assets.name: start-background
assets.prompt: Create ORIGINAL production background artwork for the START / LOADING SCREEN of a dark woodland fantasy mobile action RPG, titled Guardians of Nature (DO NOT draw the title or any letters). Landscape 3:2 canvas, designed to crop beautifully to a narrow portrait phone. Art direction: mature, dark, high quality STYLIZED game key art in the visual genre of Diablo Immortal, painterly sculpted shapes, controlled brushwork, believable but deliberately illustrated materials. Absolutely NOT photorealism, NOT a photo, NOT live action, NOT soft pastel, NOT cute or chibi. This is original woodland fantasy, not Diablo characters or logos. Deep forest-green, charcoal, desaturated slate, restrained warm amber torch accents, muted aged bronze. A weathered limestone sanctuary gateway in an ancient conifer/broadleaf forest with a distant narrow bell tower and a winding stone path, moss, roots, softly separated mist layers. The main distant gateway should be within the central safe third, framed by large dark trees, with handcrafted, simplified yet rich planes. Balanced dramatic light, readable midtones, no crushed black or glaring gold. IMPORTANT UI COMPOSITION: large calm DARK negative space across the upper central 40 percent for a live Korean title, and a quiet dark bottom central area for a real start button and loading bar. Keep all essential environmental storytelling in the middle 45 percent so both 9:16 crop and wide landscape work. No human characters. No HUD, no interface frames, no buttons, no typography, no symbols resembling text, no watermark. Hand illustrated AAA mobile RPG marketing background, NOT an isometric gameplay screenshot.

assets.name: warrior
assets.prompt:
ORIGINAL character illustration asset for the same dark woodland-fantasy mobile action RPG. Mature STYLIZED AAA game illustration in the visual genre of Diablo Immortal: painterly sculpted shapes, controlled edge detail, tactile illustrated armor and cloth, strong readable silhouette. NOT photoreal, NOT a photo or actor, NOT live action, NOT anime, NOT chibi, NOT cute, NOT pastel. Original character, no Diablo characters, logos or copied costume. Charcoal, desaturated forest green, slate, weathered dark iron, worn leather, restrained aged-bronze accents. Dramatic readable soft key light and cool edge light; retain face and clothing midtones. Tall2:3 composition, a complete heroic three-quarter figure from head to below knees, head and hands safely inset at least8percent, centered, looking slightly toward viewer. Clean TRANSPARENT background, no setting, no scenery, no UI, no frame, no pedestal, no letters, no watermark, no baked text. Stylized materials and clearly designed painted facial planes, not skin-pore realism. Each character is a useful UI art cutout with clean alpha, not an in-game sprite.
CHARACTER: A resolute male forest guardian warrior in his early thirties, angular illustrated face, short windswept dark chestnut hair, light stubble, deep muted green half-cloak, practical layered dark iron shoulder plates, worn brown leather brigandine and gauntlets. A simple broad sword points downward beside the body, one hand rests on its hilt; a restrained battered shield tucked at his other side. Powerful grounded silhouette, not bulky oversized armor. No fur collar obscuring face, no gold filigree, no spikes or skull costume. His expression is calm, experienced and determined.
